title: Hard Rock
tagline: Loud guitars, powerful drums, and riffs made to fill a room.
summary: Hard rock amplifies rock and blues traditions with distorted guitar riffs, assertive vocals, and driving rhythms. It became a major force in album-oriented music and live performance, influencing metal as well as later alternative styles. The sound can be bluesy, theatrical, or highly polished, but it keeps electric guitar at its center.

pillars.name: Led Zeppelin
pillars.why: Led Zeppelin combined blues-derived riffs, powerful performance, and dynamic arrangements in a highly influential hard-rock sound.

pillars.name: The Who
pillars.why: The Who brought explosive volume and dramatic stage performance to the development of hard rock.

pillars.name: Deep Purple
pillars.why: Deep Purple paired heavy guitar and organ with virtuoso playing and forceful songwriting.
